# Quaternius — Ultimate Stylized Nature (CC0)

Models by Quaternius — https://quaternius.com · License: CC0 1.0 (see `License.txt`; its header text is
Quaternius' generic template). Files from the pack's `glTF/` folder (mirror: https://github.com/320trankt/warcell).
Used: Grass_Large_Extruded, Grass_Small and Flower_3_Clump, Flower_4_Clump (opaque geometry, flowers
recoloured pink / gold / violet per instance). `Grass.png` / `Flowers.png` are only sampled for colour and are
not shipped to Unity. (Leaf-card bushes were replaced by faceted procedural foliage, `arch_geo.blob`.)
